manifest.name: GitHub notifications
manifest.description: Pushes your GitHub notifications (review requests, mentions, assignments, CI results) to all your devices.
manifest.author: Ferry

settings.label: GitHub token
settings.help: Create one at github.com/settings/tokens with only notifications read access (classic token: the notifications scope). It is only ever sent to api.github.com.

settings.label: Only these reasons (optional)
settings.help: Comma list, e.g. review_requested, mention, assign, ci_activity. Leave empty for all.
